name: diecast-gallery
description: A fast, good-looking gallery for your diecast car collection — Cloudflare Pages + Workers + D1, no framework.

scripts.db:schema: wrangler d1 execute diecast-db --remote --config worker/wrangler.toml --file db/schema.sql
scripts.db:seed: wrangler d1 execute diecast-db --remote --config worker/wrangler.toml --file db/seed.sql
scripts.db:schema:local: wrangler d1 execute diecast-db --local --config worker/wrangler.toml --file db/schema.sql
scripts.db:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute diecast-db --local --config worker/wrangler.toml --file db/seed.sql
scripts.deploy: npm run build:css && npm run deploy:worker && npm run deploy:site
